content:
The passage emphasizes Asian and African independence, rehabilitation after colonial rule, and preserving peace to allow "revolutions" to run their course.  
Gender equality (A) is not the main theme. Communism (B) is plausible but not explicitly indicated; the conference included non-communist states. Environmental conservation (D) is anachronistic for 1955 in this context.  
The Bandung Conference focused on promoting Afro-Asian solidarity against colonialism and neocolonialism, so the "revolutions" refer to decolonization movements.  

Final answer: (C)
